description: Infraestructura de Acueducto y Alcantarillado Comunitario is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital del Hábitat - SDHT. Ubicación de la infraestructura del acueducto comunitario, autoabastecedor u otra organización de pequeño prestador, en zonas donde no tiene cobertura de servicio la Empresa de Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Bogotá EAAB, localizada en el distrito capital. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital del Hábitat - SDHT. Its tags are Acueducto, Hábitat, SDHT, alcantarillado, serivios públicos. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-07-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
